What Is Digitail?

Digitail is an ai-native, all-in-one platform for modern veterinary clinics that has been making waves in the veterinary software space since its founding in 2017. Headquartered in San Francisco, CA, Digitail offers a fully cloud-based solution that aims to bring artificial intelligence into the daily workflow of veterinary teams. With over 10,000+ teams using the platform, it has quickly established a strong foothold among modern practices.

What sets Digitail apart from legacy PIMS is its AI-first approach. The platform was built from the ground up with machine learning at its core, particularly in clinical documentation. Their Tails AI feature automates SOAP note generation, which we found to be a genuine time-saver for busy clinicians. The system targets small animal, general practice, multi-location practice types, and it performs best in clinics that are ready to embrace technology to streamline operations.

Digitail operates on a per veterinarian/month pricing structure, starting at $150/mo. While that places it above the budget tier, the AI capabilities and all-in-one feature set can deliver meaningful ROI for practices that fully adopt the platform.

Key Features

We evaluated every major feature of Digitail. Here is a breakdown of what the platform offers.

AI SOAP notes (Tails AI)

Automatically generates clinical notes from appointment data, saving veterinarians significant documentation time each day.

Automated charge capture

Reduces missed charges by automatically linking treatments and procedures to invoices as they happen.

Client communication app

A dedicated pet parent app that lets clients book appointments, view records, and communicate with the practice.

Inventory management

Track stock levels, set reorder points, and manage suppliers from a unified dashboard.

Online booking

Clients can self-schedule appointments 24/7, reducing front desk phone volume.

Telemedicine

Built-in virtual visit capabilities for follow-ups and non-emergency consultations.

Payment processing

Integrated payment collection with support for in-clinic and online payments.

Reporting & analytics

Dashboards and reports covering revenue, appointments, clinical metrics, and practice performance.

Our Value Assessment

At $150/mo, Digitail sits in the mid-range of the veterinary PIMS market. The pricing is competitive for the features offered, though practices should evaluate whether they will use enough of the platform to justify the monthly cost.

Who Is Digitail Best For?

Based on our testing, Digitail is the strongest fit for the following practice types.

1

Multi-location clinics

Digitail handles the complexity of managing multiple clinic locations from a single platform, with consolidated reporting and centralized data.

2

Growing practices

Digitail's features align well with the needs of practices focused on growing practices.

3

AI-forward teams

Digitail leverages technology to automate routine tasks and surface actionable insights, which appeals to forward-thinking practice teams.

Who Should Look Elsewhere?

No software is perfect for every practice. Here are situations where Digitail may not be the best fit.

  • Solo practitioners or very small practices on a tight budget may find Digitail's starting price of $150/mo steep compared to more affordable alternatives like Shepherd ($99/mo).
  • Practices that prefer on-premise, server-based software will not find that option here. Digitail is cloud-only.
  • Clinics that need a deeply established ecosystem with decades of proven reliability may prefer a more mature platform like ezyVet or Cornerstone, as Digitail is a relatively newer company.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is Digitail cloud-based?
Yes. Digitail is a cloud-based platform. You can access it from any device with a web browser and an internet connection. There is no server hardware to purchase or maintain.
Does Digitail offer a free trial?
Yes, Digitail offers a free trial so you can test the platform before committing. We recommend using the trial period to evaluate the features most important to your practice, such as scheduling, medical records, and any integrations you rely on.
What is Digitail's starting price?
Digitail starts at $150 per month. The pricing model is per veterinarian/month, so your actual cost may vary depending on your practice size and configuration. Contact Digitail directly for an exact quote tailored to your needs.
Is Digitail good for small practices?
Digitail can work for small practices, but it is primarily designed for multi-location clinics. Smaller practices may find that they are paying for features they do not need. We recommend evaluating alternatives like Shepherd ($99/mo) or Hippo Manager ($120/mo) if you run a small or solo practice.
